A '''stun collar''' was a device used to control creatures. Stun collars delivered a pulsed [[Stun/Legends|stun charge]] at regular intervals that kept the creatures subdued.<ref name="BG">{{WEGCite|story=Big Game (scenario)|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref> [[Jodo Kast]] made use of stun collars.<ref name="TWoD">''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''</ref>
